Samsonite / MethodNMadness

Samsonite Recycle X Project

During my internship at MethodNMadness, I animated mascots for Samsonite’s Recycle X bag line, bringing their excitement to life through playful, celebratory movement.

Mascot animation00:15–00:292-week project
The brief
Animate cute mascots to celebrate Samsonite’s new Recycle X bag line.
My contribution
I worked on the shots from 15–29 seconds, animating the mascots in action to convey celebration and excitement.
The delivery
The project ran for two weeks. I refined the animation through minor tweaks with the project manager, and the client was very happy with the delivered results.
Credits & project details

Client: Samsonite
Studio: MethodNMadness
My role: mascot animation, as an intern
Contribution: shots from 00:15–00:29
Project duration: two weeks

Evolved Multimedia / Collaboration

ASCENDA ft. Exo Thrill - HOPE

Working with Evolved Multimedia again, I captured LIDAR scans and HDRIs to match the scene’s lighting and reflections when integrating CG. My work also covered Blender lighting, video editing and picture lock in Premiere Pro, and VFX in After Effects.

LIDAR & HDRI captureBlenderPremiere ProAfter Effects
Capturing the scene
I gathered LIDAR scans and HDRIs as references for integrating CG with the filmed environment, matching its lighting and reflections.
CG & lighting
I used Blender to create the floating light and the way it casts and bounces light around the scene. The highlights show the lighting work at 0:53–0:59 and its integration with footage at 2:00–2:21.
Editing & VFX
I edited the video through picture lock in Premiere Pro, then completed VFX in After Effects, including the light bulb explosion at 0:29.
Credits & project details

Production collaboration: Evolved Multimedia
My contribution: LIDAR and HDRI capture, Blender CG and lighting, video editing, picture lock and VFX
CG: Blender
Editing: Premiere Pro
VFX: After Effects
